question: Do actual published high-flow helium-circulator operating points supply transferable efficiency evidence for the current independent-circuit candidate?
classification: Source-data intake and applicability assessment; no new compressor theory or design discovery.
primary_source: Ye et al. (2024), DOI10.11884/HPLPB202436.230444, full manuscript pp076001-1 to7, especially section3.2/Table3.
prior_art: ThermoPower CompressorBase entropy/enthalpy equations, commit e2b011ac7fd90f9cf5771f29f1aefa160550b6ee, inspected in previous checkpoint.
Perez-Martin et al.2022 DOI10.3390/jne3040029 distinguishes DEMO circulator design targets from qualification needs.
Ye2024 similarity method requires geometric, kinematic, dynamic and fluid similarity; no free scale-up of measured points.
reading_scope: Full Ye2024 PDF text read with publisher HTML Table3 cross-check; plotted design-efficiency contours are not digitized as measured efficiency. KIT2022 article read as design/readiness context only.
admitted_computations: Two source-classified operating/test rows; exclude rated row from evidence calculations.
For each row compute an explicitly conditional pressure-work/electrical-power proxy using the tabulated pressure as absolute inlet or outlet pressure.
Check observed pressure-ratio coverage against the newer header-accounted candidate; do not size equipment from massflow alone.
Numerical implementation and source-classification tests; no map regression or plant reoptimization.
source_definitions_missing: Absolute/gauge and exact pressure tap/reference states
Total-state versus static pressure rise at the table points
Shaft power and actual outlet temperature/heat leakage
Instrument uncertainties, individual repeat records and massflow measurement method
Speed-dependent map and geometric/scale similarity to a proposed fusion machine
inconsistency_to_preserve: Hot-test narrative section3.1 quotes4735.5kW at4000rpm whereas Table3 row2 gives4648kW. They are not merged or treated as a quantified uncertainty interval.
proposed_difference: Use actual tabulated operating/test observations rather than nominal/design efficiencies or inaccessible abstract-only curves.
decision: Accept a source as traceable operating evidence while rejecting unsupported transplantation as a validated isentropic efficiency or equipment map.
stop_rule: Complete four diagnostic evaluations and current-envelope comparison once. Any proposed map/plant fit remains blocked unless missing definitions and compatible coverage are supplied.
boundaries: Static pressure-work ratio is NOT a reported shaft isentropic, polytropic, or total-to-total efficiency.
Two pressure interpretations are alternatives, not physical uncertainty bounds.
No comparison treats90%fluid efficiency as directly comparable to this electrical proxy.
No published operating procedure is implemented on real equipment; no physical test, purchase, cloud resource or new email.
